capabilities: Convert selected lists into a single-column table
Convert nested lists to tables with nested items as rows
Convert nested lists to tables with nested items as columns
Handle bullet, numbered, and task lists
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to restructure an existing list into a Markdown table, which must otherwise be rewritten by hand.
summary: List conversion plugin that turns selected bullet, numbered, and task lists into Markdown tables via three commands.
